items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I saw that band in Chicago with Dodo on it, but Chuck Gentry was playing and Herbie Steward.

ctx.x: I played with him for about a month, I guess, in San Diego, at one point. Dodo was his regular pianist, but Dodo was ill.
I saw that band in Chicago with Dodo on it, but Chuck Gentry was playing and Herbie Steward.
Right. So that's how that happened, I worked with him for a month.
